def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = min(r for r,c,v in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r,c,v in cells)
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c,v in cells:
        nc = c + (r-top) - (bottom-top)
        if 0 <= nc < w:
            out[r][nc] = v
    return out
